_meta.what: Blind human labels on the judge's SINGLE binary criterion (policy_correctness).
_meta.criterion: policy_correctness: does the answer give the substantively correct response to the employee's leave-policy question per the governing addendum (right figure/entitlement/outcome), OR correctly refuse ONLY when the corpus genuinely cannot answer? 1 = correct (PASS), 0 = incorrect (FAIL).
_meta.protocol: Labelled by hand by reading eval/eval_answers.jsonl against the policy corpus, BEFORE the judge was ever run. This file is committed first; the judge run is a later commit. Commit order is the ordering proof (see RESULTS.md / git log).
_meta.scale: binary (NOT 1-10; the model cannot tell a 6 from a 7, so a within-1 tolerance would inflate agreement)
